verses.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.2: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.3: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.4: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: He is gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
verses.5: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.6: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
verses.7: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.
verses.8: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see his desire upon his adversaries.
verses.9: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.
verses.10: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.
